<!-- pr-reviewer: 1fc20d3d0e920d5d5c8901252e7e4c046e7be473 -->
**Verdict: clean. No blockers.** The head sits directly on `origin/main` 62353ac75.

## What I checked

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog.rs:166-197`
   - The gutter is `bar_width + bar_inner_margin + bar_outer_margin` from `ui.spacing().scroll`. It is not a magic number.
   - This is the same pattern as `crates/ui/src/egui_app/op_page.rs:75-83` (the operation page). That page has the same comment about the floating bar over a `check_row` checkbox.
   - When the bar does not show, the content is only narrower by the gutter width. Nothing is clipped. The rows keep their order and their right alignment.
   - The change is inside the one `ScrollArea` of this dialog. The `check_row` helper (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/layout/form.rs:103`) does not change, so no other page changes.
   - The dialog still applies through the undoable command. The diff adds no direct state write.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog_tests.rs`
   - The original "Write tool list" click assertion does not change. It stays at the 900 px window.
   - The new `manualGuideBlank` checks are behaviour checks: the row is listed, it is off by default, the click toggles it, Apply commits it with the same undo step, and Ctrl+Z removes it. The test reads the rect only for the click and the message.
   - The moved `use ... OptionValue` from the second test to the file top is correct.
3. `crates/app/tests/blind_slot.rs:140-150` and `crates/app/tests/corner_relief_safety.rs:177-188`
   - Before, each test asserted zero warnings. Now each test accepts only `StrategyFallback` with `areas == rings_fallbacks(&notes)`, and it requires `!blocks_post()`. The count is 1 only when the notes show a fallback.
   - This is the #3108 pattern of `crates/app/tests/shoulder_adaptive.rs:61-65` and `crates/app/tests/adaptive_pinch.rs:192-198`.
   - All other assertions stay. No test is ignored or removed. In `blind_slot.rs` the local `run` helper is replaced by `operation::generate` at this one call, so that the test can read the warnings. The cut checks below it do not change.
   - Is the warning true? I read the diff of merge 92935735e. In `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_hsm.rs` the fallback note text is the same as before: `RINGS_FALLBACK` is only a constant for the same words. The generator logic does not change. The only new behaviour is in `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:3741-3747`, which turns the existing note into the advisory warning. Thus these cases fell back to the Offset rings before #3108 too. The warning is true, and #3108 does not change the toolpath.

## Built

Built: not built by this review. The author's readings on this head (which sits on main 62353ac75) are:
- `desktop_post_command_opens_dialog_and_applies_declared_script_options_undoably`: ok.
- `camcraft-ui` lib: 1427 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored.
- `blind_slot`: 4 passed. `corner_relief_safety`: 3 passed.
- clippy `-D warnings`: clean for `camcraft-ui --all-targets` and for the two app test targets.
- Heavy lanes reached (`app heavy: blind_slot`, `app heavy: corner_relief_safety`) have no `#[ignore]` test, so they are empty.

## Blockers

None.

## Notes

- The Setup -> Post page can have the same overlap. `post_script_options::section` (called at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_pages.rs:57`) draws inside the `ScrollArea` of `properties_body` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:114`). That scroll area keeps no gutter. When the page is taller than the pane, the bar can lie over the right-aligned checkboxes. This is a follow-up (`P3` by the table), not a part of this fix.
- `post_dialog_tests.rs` has 403 lines (the rule is about 400). I do not see a clean split for 3 lines. Not a blocker.
- The PR body is complete: panic texts, the guilty merge for each test (#3307, #3108), the change, the results, "Not exercised", `Changelog:`, `Fixes #3384`. The before/after screenshots of the Post dialog are not in the body yet. Another agent adds them.
- The blind slot and the dogbone pocket fall back to the Offset rings for Adaptive. This is not new with #3108. It can be a quality point of the Adaptive planner for these shapes. It is not a safety point, because the rings are verified.

Coordinator: this PR merges now. It is the fix for a red main (#3384).

- Class: no refresh. The head 1fc20d3d0 is directly on `main` 62353ac75, so the author's runs are on the merged tree.
- Review: comment 7078474276 on this exact head (clean, not built by the review).
- Gate: the author's readings on this head: the `camcraft-ui` lib (1427 passed, 0 failed), `blind_slot` (4 passed), `corner_relief_safety` (3 passed), clippy clean. These are the three red steps of `main`. The post-merge gate runs the batch tier on the merge commit.
- Screenshots: the body has the before and after pictures. They are headless renders of the test harness (body edit, no push).
- Follow-up: #3390 (the Setup -> Post page can have the same overlap).
